integrity.claim_scope: Exact finite-sample identities plus proved binomial large-deviation and central-limit limits; finite computations are only checks.
integrity.originality_risk: An equivalent binomial-tail observation may exist under different relative-utility or decision-curve terminology; no such statement was found in the inspected sources.

scientific_limitations: Independent identically distributed Bernoulli outcomes with a common known risk are assumed.
The result concerns observed sample relative utility at one fixed threshold and does not cover heterogeneous risks, dependent outcomes, estimated probabilities, or adaptive thresholds.
The local asymptotic profile uses q_n=t+c/sqrt(n) with q_n remaining in (0,1).
title: Exact binomial phase diagram for zero observed relative utility under perfect risk probabilities
